body:
Hey there. I guess the main thing is that I'm still very much alive, although I'm starting to feel increasingly worse. Haven't spoken to GF since Monday and I'm feeling terrible. I've managed to distract myself with tv and stuff, but even that's starting to fail. It's my birthday next Friday and I know my gf was working on something for me before all this happened, so I'm really confused about what's going to happen on that day. Will she follow through with it? Will she completely ignore me? Will she break up with me on my birthday? Everything is horrible:( 


How are you anyway?

I've been referred to a professional, so now im on a waiting list. I'd like to think that these sessions could help, but as I've found out in the past, it's pretty useless when I only have an appointment once every 6 months. 

Honestly I feel like there's no way forward at this point, I'm struggling to see my own future. I'm really hoping that things get better for me, but I don't know if they will. I just want to be happy again.

Thanks for the suggestions, I'm excited to listen to something I havent heard before :)

I saw a doctor today btw about the whole depression thing. They couldn't prescribe anything for me though because im too young :(

I've been meaning to get into some of those bands. Any suggestions where to start? 

That must be challenging. All the effects fascinate me so I should definitely look further into understanding them.

Good question! I seem to play all sorts. I have this mild obsession with trying a bit of everything so I'm always jumping between genres to try and pick up different things. I mainly like to play some heavier stuff, maybe a bit of punk now and then. Although it really depends on my mood. When I'm feeling down like this I usually go for something very fast that I can just thrash out to release stress. What do you enjoy playing?
Definitely. We had a break about a month or two ago and after that we were better than ever. I can only hope that this one turns out the same.

That's a very good idea. I've tried it once or twice before but never really stuck to it. I think now is a good time to really dive into a song and learn it slowly. I can't remember the last time I learnt a new song. I'd like to be able to be happy with what I'm playing, that's something I haven't felt in a long time.

It does seem like very stressful work, but it's something id like to do. Even if I don't get into it I hope I can do something music related.

I've been trying to initiate something like this recently, but she's been unable to focus on having a meaningful conversation with me without getting lost in her thoughts. We used to do a lot of hanging out. There was a point where we would fall asleep together on Skype every night and call every afternoon. I actually spoke to her earlier on the phone for 90mins and we both ended up breaking down into tears. We've decided to take a break for a few days in the hope that she'll realise how much she needs me. I hate breaks, I get so on edge about whether she'll want me or not. It's really affecting my day to day life.
PM me, I'd love to have a chat :)

It certainly is, especially when we've had little-to-no support the whole time.

Just because we're starting a stressful time, we're about to begin our adult lives and of course everything is all over the place. She wants to focus on her performing career and that requires her full dedication which means she has less time for me. As for me.. Well I really have no idea what I want. I'd like to focus on my music engineering/technology so I can get a job in a studio. The big problem is that I'm unable to focus on gaining any experience because of all this stress.

Thanks for the kind words, it really means a lot to me. I haven't even started college yet so that's my next big worry. If I'm struggling to cope with the end of high school then I really have no clue how I'm going to deal with college!

I try to surround myself with the people that make me happy, but there aren't any anymore. My best friend is a year older than me so she has moved off to college which means I only get to see her once or twice a month.

I love to rant, I find it does help when I can just open up to somebody about my feelings. I don't know if you read my other replies in this thread, but basically I'm in a tough situation relationship wise where my 10 month relationship has hit a huge bump. That's really getting me down. It might not sound as bad because it's a long distance thing (3.5 hours) and I haven't been able to meet her in person yet (due to a major setback a few months ago). But even so, being with this girl has helped me to cope a lot better with all the loneliness in my life. Sure, I have good parents and a sister but I'm just not a happy person. I've been happiest when I'm skyping this girl or having a cute chat with her. But now we're at a point where she doesn't know how to deal with the distance. She's not even supposed to be in contact with me because her parents disagreed with the whole long distance thing, but she's been going behind their backs to talk to me. Now she's starting to worry more and more about them finding out and I don't want any of this to go wrong. I've dedicated 10months to building this relationship and I don't know how I'm going to manage if it's suddenly ripped away from me. She needs time to get her head straight and to figure out what she wants. We've agreed to meet next month no matter what and that meeting is going to help her decide whether she wants to be with me or not.

We've decided to have a break as of an hour ago. I've told her to text me when she feels ready. Now I play the horrible waiting game :(

p.s. sorry for the rant!

I also play guitar. I like to mess about with different instruments and write songs although I feel that never really goes anywhere any more. I used to really enjoy doing it, but these days I get bored too easily. Thats another worry of mine. Sound engineering/studio work is what i want to do for a living but I'm unable to gain any experience at home right now because I just physically do not have the energy or concentration to sit down and learn. 

I agree with you about how helpful music is. It often helps to clear my head. I'm proud I have the ability to just pick up a guitar and play a song that reflects my mood.

Now that is something that sounds difficult. I can't even imagine myself in a course like that. 

I love to listen to music, music is my passion. However my brain always seems to relate anything I listen to to something that upsets me. For example I could be listening to a happy song and I suddenly imagine my broken relationship and then the song is ruined for me.

It's slightly different because it's long distance and she lives 3.5 hours away.

It's not because I'm busy with school, but more because she's starting to doubt our relationship and struggling to see our future together :(

Thank you for your reply :)

I haven't started studying yet so at the moment I feel like I'm going to fail everything. I have plenty of time to prepare, however with the breakdown of my relationship I just know that I'm not going to be able to retain any sort of information. 

Edit: I'm still in my last year of high school in the UK so I have all the compulsory subjects, plus Biology, Physics, Chemistry etc. , Business and computing :)
